communications.subject: Charge inquiry - TXN-956366942
communications.body:
Hi,

I noticed a charge of $2100 on my statement from Travel Agency. I would like to understand this charge and request a resolution.

Regards,
Ms. Eleanor Vance

communications.subject: RE: Charge inquiry - TXN-956366942
communications.body: Global Travel Solutions claimed the booking was confirmed on their end but failed to provide any evidence of a confirmed reservation with the Grand Vista Hotel. They refused a refund, stating their standard no-show policy applied, despite their evident failure to transmit the booking to the hotel.
